column1: =IFERROR(QUERY(Data_Rekam_Medis!A1:M,"select F, count(A) where A is not null group by F order by count(A) desc label count(A) 'Jumlah_Pemeriksaan'",1),"-")
column4: =IFERROR(QUERY(Data_Rekam_Medis!A1:M,"select year(E), month(E)+1, count(A) where E is not null group by year(E), month(E)+1 order by year(E) desc, month(E)+1 desc label year(E) 'Tahun', month(E)+1 'Bulan', count(A) 'Jumlah_Kunjungan'",1),"Kolom Tanggal_Pemeriksaan harus berformat tanggal")
